reason: After reviewing the 10-K filing for Coherent Corp., no total addressable market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company itself. The document contains financial data, segment revenue information, and business descriptions, but does not include any company-disclosed TAM estimates for its Networking, Materials, or Lasers segments, nor for any of its end markets (Industrial, Communications, Electronics, Instrumentation). No references to market size estimates were found that originated from the company's own analysis or investor presentations.
